options.systemMessage:
<system_instructions>
<persona>
Senior Talent Scout specialized in Impact-Driven Roles. You value social beauty, compassion, and the democratization of technology. You are an expert at identifying "Bridge Roles" where technical AI implementation meets human-centric autonomy.
</persona>

<task>
Analyze the JD and calculate two distinct scores: 
1. "Mission Alignment Score": How much the organization's CORE purpose aligns with Social Good, Education, or Open Source.
2. "Responsibility Fit Score": How much the daily tasks allow for autonomy, AI system design, and high-empathy communication (Speaking/Listening).
</task>

<scoring_anchors_pillar_1_mission>
0.0 - 0.2: PURELY COMMERCIAL. Banks, standard SaaS, Retail, or Insurance. (Baseline)
0.3 - 0.5: SEMI-IMPACT / LOCAL. Local small businesses or startups with a "neutral" mission.
0.6 - 0.8: CORE IMPACT. Educational platforms, Open Source contributors, or "Tech for Good" initiatives.
0.9 - 1.0: THE IDEAL MISSION. NGOs, Environmental protection, Global Education, or Non-profit humanitarian work.
</scoring_anchors_pillar_1_mission>

<scoring_anchors_pillar_2_responsibility>
0.0 - 0.3: RIGID / SILOED. Pure execution, ticket-based work, no design freedom, or purely technical dev with no human interface.
0.4 - 0.6: MODERATE / HYBRID. Some design freedom but follows strict corporate frameworks. Limited empathy/speaking requirements.
0.7 - 0.9: HIGH AUTONOMY / BRIDGE. "Own the process," create syllabuses/frameworks, design AI workflows, or lead implementation through high-empathy communication.
1.0: THE PERFECT FIT. Complete autonomy to design AI solutions/education from scratch with a focus on human-centric implementation.
</scoring_anchors_pillar_2_responsibility>

<logic_rules>
- PILLAR 1: "NGO/Charity/Non-profit" = Min 0.85. Primary product "Education" = Min 0.70. Commercial SW House cap = 0.30.
- PILLAR 2: If the JD mentions "shaping the role," "designing the framework," or "owning the strategy," increase fit by 0.2.
- PILLAR 2: If the role is purely "maintaining existing systems" or "following technical specs," cap fit at 0.4.
- PILLAR 2: Empathy/Speaking/Mentoring tasks are positive signals; don't penalize "Teaching" if there is design freedom.
</logic_rules>

<few_shot_examples>
<example>
<jd_snippet>"AI Data Solutions Engineer for a large bank. Follow existing agile processes to maintain data pipelines."</jd_snippet>
<thought_process>
Mission: Bank is purely commercial (0.15). 
Responsibility: Mentions "following existing processes" and "maintaining." Low autonomy and no mention of bridge-style communication.
</thought_process>
<mission_score>0.15</mission_score>
<responsibility_score>0.25</responsibility_score>
</example>
<example>
<jd_snippet>"AI Enablement Lead. Own the AI adoption strategy, design internal training, and coach teams on AI implementation."</jd_snippet>
<thought_process>
Mission: SaaS/Internal tool (0.40). 
Responsibility: "Own the strategy" and "Design training" signal high autonomy. "Coaching" hits empathy and speaking skills. This is a classic Bridge Role.
</thought_process>
<mission_score>0.40</mission_score>
<responsibility_score>0.90</responsibility_score>
</example>
</few_shot_examples>

<constraints>
- Thought Process: MUST be written first, then reasoning for both pillars, then the scores.
- Format: Respond only in valid JSON.
- Input Language: Czech, Slovak, English.
</constraints>
</system_instructions>

json.job_description:
## **Who We Are**

Most companies are racing to deploy AI, but very few have the foundation to make it work reliably. Atlan is building that missing layer: the context layer for enterprise AI. We connect the business context behind data so humans and agents can operate with far more accuracy and confidence. 

With backing from world-class investors including **GIC, Insight Partners, Meritech, Peak XV, and Salesforce Ventures**, we've earned the trust of most AI-forward enterprises like **General Motors, Nasdaq, Workday and Elastic**.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.

Security is a reason Atlan's customers say yes. This role is why. You'll be the technical security voice customers hear on calls and read in their reviews, the engineer who builds the systems that make those reviews faster and increasingly self-serve, and a contributor to the compliance program that keeps Atlan trustworthy at enterprise scale.

As Atlan builds Context Studio and an agentic, MCP-based platform, the security conversations you lead are increasingly about AI itself: how agents behave, how context and data are governed, and what enterprise customers need to feel confident deploying AI in their stack.

Roughly half your week is direct customer security work. The rest is building.

**What You'll Own**

- **Be the security expert enterprise customers trust.** Own calls, architecture deep-dives, and security reviews with sophisticated security teams at Fortune 500 companies across financial services, healthcare, and payments. When the deal is on the line and the question is hard, you give an accurate answer or commit to one.
- **Lead AI security conversations credibly.** Customers ask about agent behavior, MCP exposure, context governance, and ISO 42001. You can hold those conversations today, not after a ramp period.
- **Turn security reviews into an accelerator.** Own what Vanta can't handle: the cases that need judgment, the reusable artifacts that close reviews faster, and the trust center content that deflects repeat questions before they reach a human. This includes keeping Atlan's public trust centre current and genuinely useful. The measure is shorter customer onboarding, not completed questionnaires.
- **Build the automation that shrinks the manual work over time.** Design and ship AI agents that close the gaps Vanta leaves, keep evidence current, and make the security review process measurably lighter every quarter. You own these systems end to end.
- **Contribute to Atlan's compliance program** across SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA, and GDPR: evidence collection, audit support, and continuous-compliance automation. This is a real growth path as your scope expands beyond field work, not a secondary responsibility.

**What Makes You a Match**

- You've done customer-facing security work at a B2B SaaS company and can hold a credible technical conversation with an enterprise security team without losing accuracy or composure when the deal is on the line.
- You've built AI agents in production. Not prototypes, not prompts in a notebook. Real systems that replaced manual work in compliance, triage, evidence collection, or questionnaire automation.
- You understand AI and LLM security deeply enough to explain it to a customer: prompt injection, agent guardrails, MCP exposure, model and data risks, and where frameworks like ISO 42001 apply.
- You identify the gap, build the fix, and close the loop. You don't wait for someone else to execute on a commitment you made on a call.
- You're comfortable working evening IST hours to overlap with US and EU customers. This is a real part of the role, not occasional.

**Bonus**

- Hands-on experience with automation platforms like n8n or Tines
- Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA, or GDPR

## **Why Atlan?**

Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:

- **Competitive Compensation:**  We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.
- **AI Native Culture:** Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.
- **Health & Wellness**: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.
- **Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies:** We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.
- **Accelerated Growth & Learning:** Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.
- **Global, Remote-First, High-Trust:**  Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.

**More About Us**

Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking:  “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”

We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.

To learn more, visit http://www.atlan.com and follow us on [LinkedIn.](https://www.linkedin.com/company/atlan-hq/posts/?feedView=all)

***Equal Opportunity Employer***

*Atlan is committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and authentic workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.*

***Recruitment Fraud Alert***
 *Atlan only posts job openings through our official Careers page at* [*atlan.com/careers*](http://atlan.com/careers)*. Any other listings or communications claiming to represent Atlan may be fraudulent. We never ask for payment during hiring. Please report suspicious activity to* [*careers@atlan.com*](mailto:careers@atlan.com)*.*
